title: A push-forward by a map fixing spt Y pointwise equals Y
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, O ⊆ ℝ^P open, f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P of class C¹ on O (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O). Let Y, Z ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (IMRep univ n) representing Y, with spt Y ⊆ O and f(y) = y for every y ∈ spt Y. Suppose Z(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(f(x))∘Df(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (Hⁿ = μHE[n], Df(x) = fderiv ℝ f x, ω(f(x))∘Df(x) := (ω (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)). Then Z = Y.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (O : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Y Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → R.Represents Y → Y.support ⊆ O → (∀ y ∈ Y.support, f y = y) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, Z ω = ∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) ∂μHE[n]) → Z = Y
